ops.text: The requirement can be substantial for temperate sub-Neptunes around active K dwarfs: Krishnamurthy et al. (2026) estimate that TOI-8264 b would need about 17 Tier-2 transits once its JWST-measured mean molecular weight replaces the hydrogen-dominated reference.

new_bib.text: V. Krishnamurthy, N. B. Cowan, and M. Fukagawa (2026). Beyond Five Scale Heights: Composition- and Cloud-dependent Ariel Tier-2 Requirements for sub-Neptunes. arXiv e-prints.
